newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica denies signing deal with MCI.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica denies signing deal with MCI.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica de Espana denied on Monday that an accord with U.S. telecommunications group MCI would be signed today and said it was still in talks with AT&T and BT /MCI.

"Telefonica categorically denies the information published this morning by various international news agencies, dated in Lisbon, announcing the signing today of an agreement between Telefonica Internactional and MCI," Telefonica said in a statement.
Earlier, Portugal Telecom said MCI and Telefonica Internacional, an international arm of Telefonica, had formed a Pan American joint venture.
An MCI official said the Portugal Telecom reference to a Telefonica venture was an "error".
In its statement, Telefonica said the group was still in talks with AT&T as well as with MCI/British Telecom.

"Telefonica de Espana SA is still discussing with AT&T as well as with BT/MCI, a possible strategic alliances that will serve the interests of its employees, customers and shareholders," the statement said.
Telefonica said it was analysing different alternatives with maximum prudence and was not subject to time pressures.
